hook: My four year old used to fight bedtime until we tried this exact rule.
body: Nightly battles leave you completely drained while bedtime keeps dragging on. Toddlers panic when control slips away. Introducing the two minute warning changes everything. Simply offer one tiny choice right before pajamas start. Let them pick their bedtime book. That microscopic control completely stops the transition anxiety.
cta: Save this for your next chaotic bedtime struggle.
